title: Results
captureState: Seeded fixture after seed.sh (D10a): runs Baseline and Higher altitude Complete, Fin revision Outdated, Recovery test Not run; Baseline and Higher altitude selected; Altitude plot; thread 'Flight comparison' with its canned exchange.
source: concepts.md §3, §4.4; spec B1; plan D10 (U1, U12); BC0 critic (M1.15b)

items.text: Header bar across the top, about 56 px tall, flat, with a 1 px hairline below.
Rocket mark and the wordmark 'RocketWright' (the product name, not the art's name).
Project switcher showing the loaded project name ('Research vehicle') with a ▾ menu.
Save state with a cloud icon and a relative time computed from the real last save ('Saved … ago').
Centred tabs Design | Propulsion | Simulate | Results.
Results is the active tab, marked by a 2 px teal underline.
'✓ Check model' primary button: deep teal fill, 1 px teal border, white text; its state reflects the real model check result (status, issue count).
Settings gear button opening minimal settings.
Help '?' button.
Left rail, about 17% of the width, threads group above the page navigation section, hairline divider on its right.

items.source: C§3 Left rail, threads group; S:169 seeded threads
items.text: Thread rows with icon, name, and relative age: Assembly review, Fin revision, Flight comparison (seeded).
The selected thread row is highlighted.
'+ New thread' row below the threads.
Titled navigation section 'Runs' with a search icon and '+'.
Workspace column, about 58% of the width, between the rail and the agent pane.
Docked agent pane, about 25% of the width, full height below the header, hairline divider on its left (not a floating dock).
Pane head rendered by RocketWright above the embedded chat: thread icon and the open thread's title 'Flight comparison', the same thread the left rail highlights.

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; S:169 allowed deviation; U17; D10; D31
items.text: 'Agent' settings button in the pane head that opens the agent's provider and model settings (the S:169 'Agent ▾' mapping).

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; C§2 bubble/user; D31
items.text: The user's message in a teal-tinted bubble, radius about 6 px, with the round user avatar beside it.
An `rw:` app reference in the thread renders as a chip naming the entity, not as raw text; it resolves to a stable entity id and opens that entity in RocketWright.

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; C§5.5; BC0 critic; D31
items.text: App tool rows for the turn's tool calls: a leading chevron that expands the call, a tool icon, the tool's label in sans, and a teal success check.
Agent reply after the turn's tool rows and cards, written as plain prose with no bubble, under the agent's name.
Composer pinned to the bottom of the agent pane.
Composer placeholder 'Ask about these results…'.
Paperclip attach button.
Send button.
Bottom-right footer of the agent pane states the provenance of the data shown (it replaces the art's placeholder footer).
Design history strip along the bottom of the rail and workspace.

items.source: C§3 Design history strip; C§6 (02); D10
items.text: Label 'Design history', then numbered step circles joined by hairlines, each with a name and date; numbers are sequential and unique, from the seeded history.
The current step has a teal ring.
'Compare' button at the end of the strip.
'⋯' menu after Compare.
Runs rows with eye toggle, status icon, name, and status text: Baseline Complete (teal), Higher altitude Complete (sand), Fin revision Outdated (⚠), Recovery test Not run (○).
Baseline row selected with the teal tint.
Page title 'Flight results' (22-28 px).
Primary '▶ Run selected ▾' button.
'Plot ▾' menu.
'Export CSV' button.
Run table.
Columns: checkbox, colour dot, Run (sortable), Status, Apogee (m), Max speed (m/s), Flight time (s), and a '⋯' row menu.
Metric cells show the real simulation summary with units; the outdated run shows — dashes.

items.source: C§4.4 Workspace; C§2 selection row, series B
items.text: The two selected rows are tinted in their series colour: teal row A, sand row B with an amber border.
Row '⋯' menu with Edit, Duplicate, Delete, and Landing dispersion entries.
Banner '⚠ <run> uses an outdated model. Rebuild to run this simulation.' with 'Open design ↗', shown because the run's revision differs from the current one.
Plot panel.
Plot tabs Altitude | Velocity | Acceleration | Stability, Altitude active.
Altitude (m) against Time (s) axes with tick labels spanning the real flight.
Two series from the run time series: Baseline in teal, Higher altitude in sand.
Curves follow the simulated flight: descent under the parachute lasts longer than the ascent.
Direct legend '<run> (<apogee> m)' per series, values from the summaries.
Dashed vertical event lines Burnout, Apogee, Recovery placed at the simulated event times (burnout matches the motor burn time).
'Trajectory view' inset beside the plot.

items.source: C§4.4 Inset; S:169 allowed deviation; C§6 (04)
items.text: 3D trajectory arcs from the simulated position series over a flat ground plane (terrain not required).

items.source: C§4.4 Inset; D10 U12; BC0 critic
items.text: Small rocket on the pad in the inset.
Axis gizmo and a legend naming both runs in their series colours.
Run details row under the plot.
'Model Rev NN', 'Environment: …' (wind, temperature), '⚠ Warnings: N', and 'View assumptions', all from the run manifest.
The steps row ends at the step that produced the runs ('Flight runs').

items.source: C§3 Design history strip; C§4.4 History; D10 U12
items.text: Second history row of run snapshot cards.

items.source: C§3 Design history strip; D10 U12
items.text: Each snapshot card: thumbnail, '<run> run', 'Model Rev NN', timestamp, and a colour dot matching the run's series.
Tool rows for listing the runs and comparing the two selected runs, each with its chevron and a teal success check.
Run card (an MCP Apps card in the timeline) with an Open action that opens the run's details in Results.
A Compare action on a card in the thread that opens the comparison of the two runs in RocketWright.
The two compared runs referenced as `rw:sim/…` chips naming each run (Baseline, Higher altitude), not raw text.
One table row per run that has been run (Baseline, Higher altitude, Fin revision), matching the rail; a run that was never run has no row.

items.source: C§4.4 Workspace; C§2 success/warning; BC0 critic
items.text: Each Status cell shows that run's real status with its icon: teal check Complete, amber warning Outdated.
Row checkboxes multi-select runs; exactly the checked runs are tinted, overlaid in the plot, and listed in the legend.
Clicking a sortable column header re-sorts the table and shows the active sort direction.
Selecting Velocity, Acceleration, or Stability plots that real time series for the same selected runs.
The eye toggle on each Runs row hides and shows that run's series in the plot and the trajectory inset.
Export CSV writes the real run data for either all runs or only the selected ones.
Running an outdated run from '▶ Run selected ▾' reruns it against the current revision and clears its outdated banner and dashes.

Visible table columns can be customised from the full metric set (apogee, max velocity, max acceleration, time to apogee, flight time, velocity off rod, velocity at deployment, ground-hit velocity, optimum coast time, warnings).
